Are you a proven buy-side M&A professional (3-7 years experience) looking for more than just another corporate deal-making role?Do you thrive in entrepreneurial environments, enjoy taking ownership, and want to play a key role in scaling an ambitious international platform?This is a unique opportunity to become the right hand of a successful entrepreneur and directly contribute to the development of a high-growth buy-and-build strategy across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.We are partnering with an international investment group active in the industrial services and utilities sector, currently pursuing an ambitious acquisition strategy across Europe. To support this growth, they are looking for a Lead Associate Benelux who combines strong transaction expertise with a genuine entrepreneurial mindset.The group focuses on acquiring and scaling specialised businesses operating in sectors such as:

• HVAC
• Industrial air and ventilation systems
• Environmental services
• Control and utility solutions
• Technical maintenance and industrial services
The role can be located everywhere in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess available financial information and highlight relevant findings.
• Work with internal stakeholders to ensure financial inputs are complete and consistent.
• Maintain organised records and supporting documentation for transaction work.

We are looking for someone who combines strong buy-side transaction experience with the mentality of an entrepreneur.You will typically have:

• 3 to 7 years of buy-side M&A experience
• Proven exposure to deal sourcing, target screening, due diligence and acquisition execution
• Fluency in Dutch, French and English
• Experience in industrial services, HVAC, ventilation systems or utilities is considered a plus but is not essential
More importantly, you are someone who:

• Has a strong entrepreneurial drive and growth mindset
• Is ambitious and eager to accelerate their career
• Enjoys operating in dynamic, fast-growing environments
• Is comfortable working with limited bureaucracy and high levels of autonomy
• Takes ownership and accountability for results
• Sees opportunities where others see obstacles
• Is naturally proactive and self-driven
• Possesses strong emotional intelligence and relationship-building skills
• Can earn the trust of business owners and entrepreneurs
• Communicates complex topics with clarity and confidence
• Combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach
• Is humble, pragmatic and collaborative
